description: Add a file to the Media Library, either from a public URL that WordPress downloads or from base64 content with a filename. Optional title, description and alt text.

base64.description: Base64-encoded file content. Must be used together with filename.

filename.description: Filename with extension (e.g. photo.jpg). Required when using base64.

url.description: URL to download the file from. Use this OR base64/filename.

name: wp_upload_media
title: Upload media
